title: Celebrating the James Hardie ™ ALLIANCE 2025 Service Excellence & President’s Club Award Recipients
summary: Learn about these prestigious honors celebrating top-performing contractors who have demonstrated exceptional sales volume and growth, as well as outstanding service, as rated by homeowners.
body_markdown:
We’re proud to recognize the outstanding contractors honored in the 2025 James Hardie™ ALLIANCE Awards. These annual awards highlight the very best in our network—companies that consistently deliver exceptional homeowner experiences and demonstrate remarkable business performance.


The Service Excellence Awards celebrate contractors who provide truly exceptional service, rated directly by homeowners. The President’s Club Awards recognize top-performing contractors who have achieved outstanding sales volume or significant year-over-year growth. Together, these awards reflect the dedication, craftsmanship, and commitment that define the[James Hardie™ ALLIANCE](https://www.jameshardie.com/alliance/) .


Award recipients were recognized at the James Hardie™ ALLIANCE Contractor Summit in January.


2026 James Hardie™ ALLIANCE Contractor Summit


#### **2025 Service Excellence Award Winners**


We’re thrilled to celebrate the 2025 Service Excellence Award recipients—companies that continue to set the bar for quality, professionalism, and customer satisfaction. Their commitment to delivering an exceptional homeowner experience is evident in every project they complete.


30 companies met the rigorous qualifications for this honor in 2025. To earn the award, contractors qualified through one of two review-based criteria:


- GuildQuality:


- Recommendation rate above 95%.
- Minimum of 20 surveys completed, 50% response rate, and 20 jobs logged.


- Google Reviews:


- Rating of 4.9 out of 5.0.
- At least 50 verified reviews collected in 2025 and 20 jobs logged.


Other factors considered were good standing in the[James Hardie™ ALLIANCE](https://www.jameshardie.com/alliance/) and other homeowner feedback. Regardless of the qualification path, each winner demonstrated an unwavering commitment to understanding homeowner needs and delivering exceptional results.

#### **2025 President’s Club Award Winners**


We’re equally proud to announce the recipients of the 2025 James Hardie President’s Club Award. This distinction is awarded to fewer than 1% of James Hardie™ ALLIANCE members—just 32 companies across the U.S.—and truly represents the best of the best.


These contractors have shown exceptional dedication to providing[Hardie® products](https://www.jameshardie.com/product-catalog/) and have achieved either:


- Outstanding overall sales volume.
- Significant year-over-year growth within their market.


Earning a place in the President’s Club reflects strong market leadership, operational excellence, and a deep commitment to the values shared by James Hardie and the James Hardie™ ALLIANCE.
